prompt: In a cinematic film still, the humid air of a vast botanical greenhouse hangs heavy with mist. On the far left, a woman in a yellow raincoat stands beside a towering fern, her hand resting gently on its frond. Next to her, a small boy in blue overalls points excitedly at a hanging orchid, his face lit with wonder. In the center foreground, an elderly man in a tweed cap sits on a weathered wooden bench, holding a leather-bound notebook open on his lap. Beside him, a calico cat sleeps curled up on the slats, oblivious to the activity. A young woman in a white lab coat walks past them, carrying a glass terrarium containing a tiny cactus. She looks toward a tall gardener in green coveralls who is pruning a rose bush on the right side of the frame. The gardener holds a pair of silver shears in one hand and a clipped stem in the other. Near the right edge, a golden retriever sits patiently, watching a butterfly flutter near a sunflower. Above them, a glass pane reflects the silhouette of a bird perched on a metal beam. In the background, a couple shares an umbrella; the man wears a striped shirt while the woman wears a floral dress. They stand close together, looking at a map spread out on a nearby table. A brass watering can sits on the ground next to the table, gleaming under the diffuse light. A potted palm tree stands tall behind the couple, its leaves brushing the ceiling. There is no digital technology visible in the scene. There is no artificial lighting fixture exposed.
